ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER Z

Letter Z — Zebra.

A striped zebra gallops in for the letter Z — the last letter of the alphabet, wearing the most striking coat of all. Z buzzes: zzz, like a bee at the finish line.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, trace it together — then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does Z say?

“z — zzz, a buzzing sound”

Z says zzz — a busy bee buzzing: voice on, tongue close behind the teeth. Hold it out: zzzz, then buzz it around the room like a bee finding flowers.

TRACE THE LETTER

Trace Z z together.

Follow the numbers with a finger — on screen or on each other’s palms. The arrows show the way to go, the numbers show where to start, and a grown-up reads the little script below each card. Slow and wobbly is exactly right.

Trace the uppercase Z

One stroke. Start at 1 at the top left: slide across, slide down the hill, slide across the bottom — no lift.

Trace the lowercase z

One stroke. Start at 1 at the top left: slide across, slide down the hill, slide across the bottom — no lift.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Zoo parade.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    March like a zoo parade, buzzing zzz with every step.

  2. 02

    Striped-sock hunt: find the stripiest socks in the house and wear them on your hands like zebra puppets.

  3. 03

    Gallop one final lap, buzz a long zzzz and bow — the alphabet is complete.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
